protocol: one fixed actual-native-law paired ratio fit; final checkpoint only
precision: FP32 states/noise/model, TF32 disabled; FP64 scalar loss
data_pairing: uniform actual generated id; independent real endpoint within same class; stored actual initial noise shared with real noising; time fixed by actual record
initialization: same 762753 parameter architecture, new zero output head; no warm start
checkpoint_choice: update 2048 only, no checkpoint selection or temperature calibration
validation: all 1000 actual heldout ids, one real endpoint per class; compare zero and frozen old endpoint critic
entry_condition: mean loss + 2 class SE < 0 and paired change versus old critic + 2 class SE < 0

sampling_if_entry_passed.formula: native BF16 G + t^2 grad_z f
sampling_if_entry_passed.times: all original 100 including finite pure-noise extension

known_limits: frozen native law differs from guided law
classification risk does not prove gradient or FID generalization
